critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1962 lines — restock/bulk/orders/donations should be extracted into routers under backend/routers/. The single-file architecture is becoming a maintenance liability.
_send_email is synchronous requests.post inside async endpoints (blocking event loop). Fine while RESEND_API_KEY is empty; before turning on Resend switch to httpx.AsyncClient or run in a threadpool.

update_order_status has no authorisation check — any authenticated user can update ANY order's status (including cancelling other users' orders). Should verify order.user_id == user['user_id'] OR mark endpoint admin-only.
orders_checkout accepts contact_email without EmailStr validation; empty-string is silently accepted then downstream _send_email returns 'skipped'.
_mark_donation_paid still handles both donation and print_order branches — misleading function name; rename to _promote_paid_session.
bulk_import_products loops with await db.products.insert_one per row — for large CSVs use insert_many; also no dedup by title on create so duplicates are possible.
Multiple modules (_mark_donation_paid + update_order_status) duplicate the receipts-row insertion boilerplate — extract helper `_write_receipt(session_id, purpose, order_id, email, outcome)`.

external_search returns only `total_sites` (18) but the results array is capped at limit=24 so only 12 distinct sources appear by default — consumers must explicitly request limit>=36 to see all 18. Consider raising default limit or documenting this on the endpoint.

rca of the issue: Two minor issues surfaced: (1) RestockAdmin.jsx returns an early un-testidded div when stats is null (unauthenticated). Fix: wrap the 'Sign in required' block with data-testid='restock-admin'. (2) Product detail page overflows viewport by 10px at 390px width — likely a `min-w-*` class on the shipping card or chip row; use scrollWidth vs clientWidth check to bisect. Donation receipts=skipped RCA: _mark_donation_paid fetches Stripe session to get customer_details.email, but our unsigned webhook path fires before Stripe collects an email (unpaid sandbox), so email is empty → _send_email short-circuits to 'skipped'. Mitigation: persist supporter_email at checkout create-time and use tx-level email as fallback in _mark_donation_paid.
